notes.title: Various enhancements
notes.content:
We've just added some enhancements to Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple - Festive Frolics (Volume 1)...



Windowed mode

Toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode using ESC.



Steam achievements

There are now 22 achievements to collect :

Candy Cane of Prosperity - Bronze
- Collect 250 gems

Candy Cane of Prosperity - Silver
- Collect 500 gems

Candy Cane of Prosperity - Gold
- Collect 1,000 gems

Candy Cane of Vitality - Bronze
- Complete 3 consecutive levels without dying

Candy Cane of Vitality - Silver
- Complete 5 consecutive levels without dying

Candy Cane of Vitality - Gold
- Complete 7 consecutive levels without dying

Candy Cane of Fate - Bronze
- Complete 5 consecutive random levels

Candy Cane of Fate - Silver
- Complete 10 consecutive random levels

Candy Cane of Fate - Gold
- Complete 15 consecutive random levels

Candy Cane of Enlightenment - Bronze
- Find 1 hidden rune

Candy Cane of Enlightenment - Silver
- Find 3 hidden runes

Candy Cane of Enlightenment - Gold
- Find 5 hidden runes

Candy Cane of Fortitude - Bronze
- Attempt 10 levels

Candy Cane of Fortitude - Silver
- Attempt 20 levels

Candy Cane of Fortitude - Gold
- Attempt 30 levels

Candy Cane of Discovery - Bronze
- Complete level 3

Candy Cane of Discovery - Silver
- Complete level 5

Candy Cane of Discovery - Gold
- Complete level 10

Candy Cane of Endurance - Bronze
- Total of survival mode high scores - 150 gems

Candy Cane of Endurance - Silver
- Total of survival mode high scores - 200 gems

Candy Cane of Endurance - Gold
- Total of survival mode high scores - 250 gems

Candy Cane of Dominion
- Unlock all other candy canes

*** IMPORTANT NOTE ***

Achievements earned during gameplay will be awarded from the candy cane page when the relevant candy cane unlocks.



Pricing

We've also introduced a permanent price reduction.



Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
